Publish.LongDescription:
## Mochi's Hover Colors
Bright blue highlights getting in the way? Want cleaner road guides, thinner color borders, or less distracting tool previews?
**Hover Colors lets you Dim, Hide, or Change highlights, guidelines, and tool overlays so you can see your city instead of the UI.**
### Highlights
- Change highlight color, transparency, fill, and outline thickness. - **1-Click Eye button** hides/shows highlights instantly. - Works on buildings, cars, trees, citizens, props, roads, property lots, and more. - Full color picker with HEX support. - Save and quickly switch between **4 custom color presets**.
### Guidelines + Area Tools
- Change guideline colors, opacity, and line thickness. - Adjust Surface and Extractor area border thickness. - Hide Surface and Specialized Industry preview fills. - Change District border + overlay color and opacity. - Hide angle and Place/Undo hints while drawing roads or paths.
### Panel + Options
- Glass or Dark panel styles. - Collapsible sections and remembered panel position. - Move the launcher instantly between Top Left, Top Right, and Universal Mod Menu. - Works in **Editor Mode**, use the panel hotkey to open (default J). - Extra Bulldozer and other options in the Options menu.
## Good to Know
- **To start:** click the Hover Colors palette icon (top-left by default). - **Works with Recolor:** Hover Colors changes highlights, guides, overlays, and previews. Recolor changes the actual objects. - **Lightweight:** no Harmony patches and safe to remove anytime. Performance friendly, settings update when needed. - Hover over controls for quick tooltip help.
### Support + Feedback
- The easiest way to support is clicking the Like 👍 button (top right) — no donations requested. - Feedback: use the GitHub or Discord links (icons right side). PRs are welcome. - Mod is GPL-3.0-or-later open source. Clones/Forks must stay GPL and credit the original, see Github for details.
### ❤️ Credits and Thanks
**Huge thanks to everyone who helped test and support.**
- River-Mochi - mod author - Flashbond - collab, tech feedback, testing - yenyang (Recolor, Anarchy) - collab, tech feedback, testing - StarQ - tech feedback, testing - Gagaxm, Mayor Cheeks - surface-hide requests and testing - Dx, BugsyG, Necko1996, ElGendo87, Maestro - testing - =Noel= - images and testing - rzzirrah - image consultant
